notes.title: Big Butt Bobby enters Early Access!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303836/7f510a278c8b29370dfe7d53240fdcbe45e8ffd3.png[/img]

We are thrilled to announce the official release of Big Butt Bobby in Early Access!

This is a very exciting moment for us - Early Access is not only an opportunity to introduce our game to you, but also a chance to listen to your feedback and ideas. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us, so we encourage you to share your observations, suggestions, and comments about the game. With your help, we will be able to improve and refine Big Butt Bobby to create an even better gameplay experience for you!

Alongside the introduction of Early Access, we are also releasing a new game update. It includes a range of changes, including exciting boss battles, new powers for the main character, graphical enhancements, new animations and sounds, and many other improvements aimed at making the gameplay even more satisfying and exciting.

We are eagerly awaiting your feedback and experiences with Early Access, as well as embarking on a journey through the world of Big Butt Bobby together!

notes.title: Update 0.5.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added Linux support.
[*] Added support for mouse input.
While Bobby is in aiming mode, you can use the mouse to adjust angle. You can also assign mouse buttons for actions.
[*] Improved some shadows, both in terms of visual quality and performance.
[*] Added option to disable shadows (big impact on performance).
[*] Teabagging was buffed - now with each “dip” you will get multiple coins, which should reduce time spent on each enemy corpse and reduce the risk of repetitive strain injury :)
[*] Tweaked behavior of some enemies (i.e. now they shouldn't get spasms when Bobby is on the opposite side of the gap).
[*] Fixed bugs that could result in errors in the summary screen.
[*] Fixed bug that caused Bobby’s starting animation to play multiple times.
[*] Fixed bugs that caused some particle effects to not play correctly or at all.
[*] Fixed occasional visual bugs where some sprites were displayed on the wrong layer.
[*] Various other smaller fixes, visual tweaks and performance improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: KICKSTARTER starts now. DEMO available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303836/5383799f37e29029b6acfd166e3038e2af17dd49.png[/img]

Hi.

We've just launched our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/558058039/big-butt-bobby]Kickstarter campaign[/url] and released a demo of our game for download!

Big Butt Bobby is a project created by just two people, made out of passion and love for games. That is why we are very excited to share with you the results of our work so far. We invite you to download the demo and share your gameplay suggestions.

Creating the demo was a huge challenge and a wild ride for us, but this is just the beginning of this journey 🙂 We will be glad if you will hop on that train with us 🙂

We hope you enjoy the adventures of Bobby and Jiff 🙂

K2M Games
